answer: Hold each new identity's rewards in escrow that vests over six epochs, and at every epoch close run a delayed sweep comparing answers across all addresses. Any cluster whose texts look like marble chipped from one block forfeits its unvested pool to the honest graders who flagged it. A farmer planting a grove of 500 clones must pay six epochs of compute per clone before any payout reaches the summit of the vesting curve, and one detected match burns the lot, so a sybil swarm runs at a loss.
